correctness.rationale: The diagonal-2/off-diagonal-t gradient system on the active X^p,Y^p,Z^p coordinates gives precisely the stated exceptional finite parameters. At -2 the conic is smooth and the power map is étale off the coordinate axes. Its pullback has precisely 3p candidate points on the axes; each is a unibranch cusp by the displayed local equation. The coordinate-square map from the Fermat curve is generically one-to-one (no other generic sign choice works); its image has degree 2p by pullback of O(1), hence is the whole reduced special fiber. In the local equation write the deformation coefficient as the unit U(A,B), and replace A,B by A U^(-1/2),B U^(-1/p); division by U gives x²−4y^p+s^(2p)=0 exactly. In the (p,2,1)-weighted blowup the s-chart gives a²=4b^p−1. Its missing point is visible in the y-chart x=u^p v, y=u², s=u t, where v²=4−t^(2p). The residual sign exchanges the v=2 and v=−2 neighborhoods (p odd), so one chart suffices, with the transverse node u t=0 and smoothing s=u t. This gives precisely one tail at each cusp and no extra branches. The central and tail genera give a stable compact-type tree and a product connected Picard variety. Over the new disc, separating vanishing cycles give trivial action on H¹; the deck action is identity on the central component and (-a, ξ^(-2)b) on each tail. Differentials b^j db/a and conjugates supply all primitive 2p-th roots once per tail, with no graph cohomology. Thus the full polynomial and exact order follow. The inspected finite symbolic checker only tests algebra for sample primes; it was not run and is not the geometric proof.
